name: Natal

queries.query: Natal Prefeitura GeoNatal cadastro territorial Parcelas Lotes mapa cadastral GIS
queries.scope: Find the municipal city-lot map and determine whether it offers a bounded geometry-only query.
queries.result: Official GeoNatal viewer catalog lists a Cadastro Territorial group with Parcelas (Lotes) split into four city zones. Its JavaScript loads each whole static GeoJSON file directly; this is a public vector snapshot, not a server-side geometry/ID query. File schema includes extra fields (bairro, inscricao, area) in addition to id and geometry, so no feature was retained or queried.

queries.query: Natal Brazil official municipal cadastral lot parcel GeoNatal city GIS
queries.scope: Cross-check city registry activity and the published lot-vector layer.
queries.result: English-indexed official municipal sources describe the city property-cadastre database and GeoNatal parcel group. No separate safe anonymous bounded-vector API or existing Natal runtime source was verified; the state SICAR layer is rural and is not treated as urban cadastre.

portals.name: GeoNatal — Cadastro Territorial / Parcelas (Lotes)
portals.observation: Public city GIS catalogue lists four static urban lot GeoJSON snapshots, one per zone; all four returned 200 and were schema-checked. Snapshot field names/types: id integer, bairro string, inscricao string, area number; all geometries MultiPolygon in OGC:CRS84. No owner/person/address/account fields were present. Extra area and municipal inscription metadata were not retained in samples.

portals.name: Natal municipal Cadastro Técnico Multifinalitário materials
portals.observation: Official city technical specification calls for a municipal spatial CTM database covering properties, blocks and lots, with spatial IDs for administrative use. No personal/property record was queried.

portals.name: SICAR RN rural property layer (excluded from city lots)
portals.observation: Existing research record is explicitly rural, self-declared environmental property perimeters; it is not Natal urban-lot cadastre and is not a substitute for GeoNatal.

source.name: GeoNatal municipal Parcelas (Lotes) GeoJSON snapshots
source.serviceType: Four public static full-zone GeoJSON snapshots loaded by GeoNatal. A temporary run of the existing geojson-snapshot adapter against Zona Oeste returned complete bounded coverage at the population centroid; this was a manual descriptor with raised snapshot byte/feature limits, not an app/config mutation.
source.nativeIdEvidence: All 212,431 zone features expose id as integer according to schema inspection. The temporary WUP-centered adapter query returned IDs 89327, 89531, and 90357. Legal cadastral-number semantics remain unconfirmed.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: GeoNatal public municipal catalogue lists full-zone parcel GeoJSON snapshots for Natal urban zones Sul, Leste, Oeste, Norte.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Existing snapshot adapter passed 13 aligned cells, four pans, all 786 bounded identities after a second complete HTTP 200 file read, absence and footprint intersection. Independent GEOS in EPSG:32725 found one duplicate normalized-geometry group and 50 parcel pairs overlapping above 0.01 m². Runtime is held for source topology; no filtering or repair was applied. The observed Oeste file contains 51,598 features; no publisher ETag was provided. Other zones remain unqualified.

remainingUncertainty: Whether all zone files are a coherent current and exhaustive parcel fabric, whether numeric id is an official legal parcel identifier, cross-zone ID uniqueness, inter-zone seams/overlap, and public reuse terms. Only Zona Oeste around the population centroid was geometry-tested. Last-Modified suggests dated publication but no ETag protects source revision.
nextStep: Retain topology evidence; await a publisher revision or demonstrated coherent source fabric before runtime enablement.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The official city GeoNatal portal directly publishes the urban Parcelas (Lotes) layers; city CTM material identifies the municipal parcel database as a city-managed spatial dataset.

verifiedParcelResponse.method: GET through existing geojson-snapshot adapter (temporary descriptor)

Full source polygons were returned without clipping. No owner/address/tax/account values were retained.
verifiedParcelResponse.attributePolicy: Only numeric source id plus complete geometry retained. Other published fields (bairro, inscricao, area) were schema-checked by name/type and discarded from the sample artifacts.
